name: Semantic Scholar
summary: Free AI-powered search and discovery tool for scientific literature.
description: Semantic Scholar searches 238,736,094 papers and uses machine learning to extract meaning and surface relevant citations and connections. It is free to use, offers the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API and monthly downloadable datasets for developers, and includes the Semantic Reader augmented PDF reader (beta).
contains: 238,736,094 papers indexed, all fields of science
Semantic Scholar Academic Graph (S2AG) RESTful API
monthly downloadable datasets and S2ORC corpus
personal library, research feeds, alerts and recommendations
no mobile app; desktop and mobile web
